nodes.label: A6 Passcode Verification Screen
nodes.rationale: Second step of sign-in: one-time passcode challenge. Headline 'Enter your passcode' with the subhead 'We sent a 6-digit code to +974 3312 3456' echoing the exact number entered on A5, so the user can verify the destination without going back. Reuses the A5 header band and card shell verbatim; adds a circular back button at top-left, the first screen in the flow to have one.

nodes.label: Six-Digit OTP Input
nodes.source_location: credential card, six segmented boxes in a row
nodes.rationale: Six discrete rounded boxes rather than one text field. Design state shown mid-entry: '4', '0', '2' filled, box four holding the caret and outlined in gold as the focus ring, boxes five and six showing dot placeholders. Segmenting the code makes length legible at a glance and gives per-digit focus feedback.

nodes.label: Resend Code Countdown
nodes.source_location: between the OTP boxes and the Verify pill
nodes.rationale: 'Resend code in 0:42' - a disabled-until-expiry countdown rather than an always-live resend link. Rate-limits SMS re-sends and sets the expectation that waiting is normal, while promising the action will become available.

nodes.label: Verify Action
nodes.rationale: Primary CTA in the same gold pill slot the 'Send passcode' button occupies on A5, giving the two-step sign-in a consistent commit position.

nodes.label: Change Number Link
nodes.source_location: below the credential card, gold text link
nodes.rationale: Correction path back to A5 for a mistyped number, occupying the same slot below the card that 'Have an invitation code?' occupies on A5 - the position is reserved for the screen's secondary escape route.

nodes.label: Front Desk Human Fallback
nodes.source_location: footer, replacing the A5 legal notice
nodes.rationale: 'Didn't receive it? Check your SMS filter or call the front desk on 4020 1666.' Terminates the failure branch in staff rather than in software - the hospitality context supplies a human recovery path that a generic consumer app lacks. Occupies the footer slot A5 gives to the legal notice, so the footer is a per-screen support slot. Naming the likely cause (SMS filtering) before the phone number tries self-service first.
